```yaml
name: Repo Commands

on:
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]

permissions:
  contents: write
  issues: write

jobs:
  commands:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: ${{ github.event.issue.pull_request == null && github.event.comment.user.login == 'PrismarineJS' }}
    steps:
      - name: Check command
        id: check
        run: |
          COMMENT="${{ github.event.comment.body }}"
          if [[ "$COMMENT" == "/makerelease" ]]; then
            echo "command=makerelease" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "command=none" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Checkout code
        if: steps.check.outputs.command == 'makerelease'
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Setup Node.js
        if: steps.check.outputs.command == 'makerelease'
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        if: steps.check.outputs.command == 'makerelease'
        run: npm ci

      - name: Make Release
        if: steps.check.outputs.command == 'makerelease'
        run: |
          npm version patch --no-git-tag-version
          npm publish
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}

      - name: Commit and Push
        if: steps.check.outputs.command == 'makerelease'
        uses: EndBug/add-and-commit@v9
        with:
          author_name: "github-actions[bot]"
          author_email: "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          message: "chore: release new version"
          push: true
```
